text: (Application materials must be prepared in either Chinese or English and will not be returned to candidates nomatter they are accepted or not.) 1. UIBE Application Form 2. A copy of high school graduation certificate and transcripts 3. A copy of guarantor’s passport or ID 4. A copy of passport or other identification 5. Two recent passport photos, white background, frontal view, no hat 6. A copy of TOEFL, or IELTS, or GRE, or Cambridge International AS, A Level, IGCSE, or IB scores report, etc. The minimum score for TOEFL is 86 and 6.0 for IELTS, or BBC level or above for A Level, or satisfactory GRE scores, etc., (If high school courses are taught in English, please submit the official letter about the applicant’s English proficiency). 7. Asset certificate(if needed,i.e. current deposit on the bank statement shall be able to cover program tuition) 8. Certificate of No Criminal Conviction 9. Entry requirements of the IUP for certificate holders of the Cambridge International Examination (A-level).
